whenToUse: A large photo, map, or quote background in the middle of an article.
You give a visual pause while keeping the text narrow.
Section backgrounds on a landing page.
whenNotToUse: The photo is small and would blur when stretched.
The text already spans the full screen.
Content that's hard to read when wide, such as tables or code.

alternatives.name: Hero Section
alternatives.reason: A large visual on the first screen.

accessibility: Text keeps a comfortable measure (about 60 characters) so lines don't get too long.
It doesn't use 100vw, so no horizontal scrollbar appears.
Decorative images are aria-hidden, and informative ones have alt text.
The DOM order is unchanged, so the reading flow isn't broken.
